entry.summary:
Source: @miladdokhanchi

In this audio, dedicated to the fifth session of the commentary on Jalal Al-e-Ahmad's "Weststruckness" (Gharbzadegi), Milad Dokhanchi offers a reading of Jalal's theoretical framework and its relation to our current political and social situation. Following Jalal, Dokhanchi believes that the state of "demon-possession" (jinn-zadegi) among us Iranians still persists. @miladdokhanchi
